verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents a public API with its own reference pages, including a fetch-a-web-page endpoint. The docs cover Scrape, Crawl and Extract APIs that each run in a single call, agent tasks started with one API call, programmatically controllable sessions, and official SDKs. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API usage depth.
